name: Skimming Stones
tagline: Ones that skip, and ones that don't.
summary: Flat stones that skip, round stones that don't, and one very large stone. Slate offcuts from a quarry.
concept: Tumbled slate stones in three kinds. Skips are flat and thin. Doesn't Skip are round and thick. The Boulder is one very large stone.
why_it_exists: Flat stones are easy to find only when you don't need them. These are picked for the job, and so are the ones that won't do it.
target_customer: People who skim stones, and people who want a very large stone.

physical.form: Tumbled slate stones: flat discs (Skips), round thick stones (Doesn't Skip) and one very large stone (The Boulder).
materials: Slate offcuts from a working quarry
physical.dimensions: Skips: 45 to 65 mm across, 5 to 8 mm thick. Doesn't Skip: 45 to 60 mm across, 25 to 40 mm thick. The Boulder: about 250 mm across.
physical.weight: Skips about 55 g each. Doesn't Skip about 120 g each. The Boulder about 4 kg.

features: The Skips are five flat stones, which are thin enough to skip across still water.
The Doesn't Skip stones are round and thick, so they sink, and we are honest about that.
The Boulder is one very large stone of about 4 kg, and it is just a big stone.
All of them are slate offcuts from a quarry, so no stone was taken from a beach.
They are priced from £6, so a handful costs less than lunch.
arrives: The small stones come in a brown card sleeve inside a padded paper envelope. The Boulder travels in a sturdy box with card padding, because it is heavy, so it goes Soon only. When the parcel lands, take it in with both hands if it is the Boulder.
specs: Skips: 45 to 65 mm across, 5 to 8 mm thick. Doesn't Skip: 45 to 60 mm across, 25 to 40 mm thick. The Boulder: about 250 mm across.
Skips about 55 g each (about 275 g for five). Doesn't Skip about 120 g each (about 600 g for five). The Boulder about 4 kg.
Slate offcuts from a working quarry, tumbled smooth in a drum. Unwaxed.
Natural slate: grey, blue-grey and some darker banding. Each stone differs.
Flat. 5 stones, in a card sleeve.
Round and thick. 5 stones, in a card sleeve.
One stone, in a sturdy box. Standard delivery only.
Rinse in fresh water if you like. They need nothing else.
how_it_works: Hold a Skips stone between thumb and curled finger. Throw it low and flat, with spin, at still water. Doesn't Skip stones sink. The Boulder is a stone.
in_the_box: Skips or Doesn't Skip: five stones in a card sleeve
The Boulder: one stone in a sturdy box

accessories.name: Stone Pouch
accessories.tagline: A pouch that holds five stones.
accessories.description: A waxed canvas drawstring pouch that holds five Skips or five Doesn't Skip stones, so they do not rattle around in a bag or pocket. It does not fit The Boulder.
specs: 14 cm wide x 13 cm tall x 6 cm deep (base)
About 10 cm wide when the drawstring is loose
5 stones: five Skips (45 to 65 mm across), or five Doesn't Skip (45 to 60 mm across, about 600 g). Does not fit The Boulder.
Waxed cotton canvas, polyester cord, plastic cord toggle
Orange with a pink cord and a sky blue toggle
Wipe with a damp cloth. Do not machine wash.

compatibility.note: It holds five Skips or Doesn't Skip stones. It does not fit The Boulder.
Do not put stones in the Starter Puddle. They chip it.

packaging: Small stones come in a kraft card sleeve in a padded paper envelope. The Boulder is packed in a sturdy box with card padding. All card is recyclable.

warranty.summary: It has a 12-month warranty for a stone that arrives cracked through. Chips from throwing and stones lost in water are not covered. See Warranty.

care: Rinse in fresh water if you like. They don't need anything else.
Take stones home or leave them where you found a flat spot. Do not leave them in flower beds.
safety: Throw only at open water with nobody in the way.
The Boulder weighs about 4 kg. Keep it off your feet.
Small stones are a choking hazard for young children.

delivery.note: Soon only. The Boulder is heavy, so it cannot go Sooner.

returnable.note: You can return stones within 30 days if they have not been thrown and are in their sleeve. Thrown stones cannot be returned. See Returns.

sections.title: Skips and Doesn't Skip
sections.body: Skips are five flat stones for £12. Doesn't Skip are five round stones for £6, and they sink.

sections.title: The Boulder
sections.body: One very large stone for £18, about 4 kg. It is not for throwing.

sections.title: Where they come from
sections.body: They are slate offcuts from a quarry, tumbled smooth. None are taken from beaches.

faq.a: Skips are flat and thin and skip on still water. Doesn't Skip stones are round and sink.

faq.q: How many stones do I get?
faq.a: Five of Skips or Doesn't Skip. The Boulder is one stone.
About 250 mm across and about 4 kg.
Yes, within 30 days, if they have not been thrown.

faq.q: Does the Stone Pouch fit them?
faq.a: It holds five Skips or Doesn't Skip stones. It does not fit The Boulder.

steps: Hold it between thumb and curled finger.
Throw it low and flat, with spin, at still water.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: It takes practice. Doesn't Skip stones will never skip.

steps: Photograph the stone and the packaging.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: Contact support with your order number and the photo.
